inputs.prompt: Stop-motion puppet animation, animated on twos with a subtle handmade stutter. Handcrafted felt puppets and miniature sets, visible stitches and cloth texture, tilt-shift depth of field, gentle practical-light flicker. SCENE: TOME closes her ledger book with a soft pat, straightens her back and folds her white-gloved hands, then slowly turns to face the camera and holds perfectly still, looking straight into the lens. CAMERA: Static medium shot. DURATION: about 3 seconds of motion then a long held pose. All dialogue is WORDLESS: characters only murmur soft non-verbal sounds (mm,uu); the acting reads through small head tilts, shoulder shifts and hand gestures. NEVER add mouths or any facial features the puppets do not have. Keep every character and the set exactly as in the start frame: no morphing, no redesign, no new characters, no duplicates, nothing appears or disappears. ABSOLUTELY NO editorial overlays: no captions, subtitles, titles, telops, logos or musical notes composited on the picture. Text on props inside the world is allowed ONLY as this world's ORIGINAL INVENTED SCRIPT — abstract handwritten-looking glyphs that are NOT Japanese, NOT Latin letters, NOT real numerals and never readable. Motions are small, precise and stop-motion-like.
